mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates monetary easing, which reduces discount rates for equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are not significantly positive during periods of declining FEDFUNDS (t-test p>0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over 2-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: A rising unemployment rate above 8.0% (UNRATE) signals labor market weakness, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5d returns are positive in > 60% of instances when UNRATE > 8.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate broad demand contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: When both HOUST and RSAFS decline, SPX 60d returns are positive in > 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production (INDPRO < 95.0) during economic expansions signals supply-side weakness, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In economic expansions, INDPRO decline does not lead to negative 20d returns (t-test p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A higher quarterly GDP level (GDPC1) reflects a strong economic base, supporting positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: GDPC1 level does not predict SPX 20d returns (Rank IC < 0.03) over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Accelerating inflation (CPIAUCSL > 3.0%) prompts monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5d returns are positive in > 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 3.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in unemployment (UNRATE) and decline in payroll growth (PAYEMS) indicates labor market deterioration, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE rises and PAYEMS declines, SPX 20d returns are positive in > 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Rising industrial production (INDPRO > 100.0) during economic expansions signals strong supply-side activity, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In economic expansions, INDPRO rise does not lead to positive 60d returns (t-test p>0.05).
